description:
TikTok Profile Scraper: Followers, Likes & Bio

Public TikTok profile stats with exact counts: followers, following, likes, video count, bio, bio link, verified flag, avatar and account creation time. No login, no browser. $0.25 per 1,000 profiles.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Profile: $0.00025; platform usage billed to your account.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/tiktok-profile-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

maxItems.description: Hard cap on how many profiles one run handles (1 to 10000). Extra entries in the list are skipped and the status message says so.
maxItems.title: Max profiles per run

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is the default and works for TikTok profiles. Set useApifyProxy to false to go direct from the Apify platform. Do not use residential proxies: TikTok serves them a page without any profile data. A proxy failure fails the request, it never silently falls back to a direct one.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

usernames.description: Public TikTok profiles to fetch. Any of these forms works: nasa, @nasa, https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa, or a video URL such as https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa/video/123 (the @handle is read from it). Duplicates are dropped. Entries that cannot be read come back as free error rows. Leave empty to get @nasa.
usernames.title: TikTok profiles

name: tiktok_profile
